name: document_exact_session_normalization_native_wearing_v1

normalizers.frozen_legacy: subtract Rest median; divide by max(active absolute Q95, epsilon)
normalizers.document_exact_v2: subtract Rest median; divide by active absolute Q95 plus epsilon

comparison: Fit separate source models using the corresponding source normalizer, then fit each same-user session normalizer and anchors only on R_0. Compare all six branches and two provider families on identical unlabeled R_1 native trials. No target evaluation trial enters fit; no model or rule is selected from these results.
scope: Retrospective numerical-sensitivity experiment on six previously inspected public users at eight channels and 200 Hz; not a new accuracy holdout, verified physical re-donning, or own-device 250 Hz result.
